name: ballerina/sql
description: This module provides the generic interface and functionality to interact with an SQL database. The corresponding

typeDefs.name: SUCCESS_NO_INFO
typeDefs.description:
Constant indicating that the specific batch statement executed successfully
but that the count of affected rows is unavailable.

typeDefs.name: EXECUTION_FAILED
typeDefs.description: Constant indicating that the specific batch statement failed.

typeDefs.name: TRANSACTION_READ_COMMITTED
typeDefs.description: Read committed isolation level

typeDefs.name: TRANSACTION_READ_UNCOMMITTED
typeDefs.description: Read uncommitted isolation level

typeDefs.name: TRANSACTION_REPEATABLE_READ
typeDefs.description: Repeatable read isolation level

typeDefs.name: TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE
typeDefs.description: Serializable isolation level

typeDefs.name: ColumnConfig
typeDefs.description: Defines the database column name which matches the record field. The default value is the record field name.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The database column name

typeDefs.name: Client
typeDefs.description: Represents an SQL client.

fields.name: maxOpenConnections
fields.description:
The maximum number of open connections that the pool is allowed to have. Includes both idle and in-use
connections. The default value is 15. This can be changed through the configuration API with the
`ballerina.sql.maxOpenConnections` key

fields.name: maxConnectionLifeTime
fields.description:
The maximum lifetime (in seconds) of a connection in the pool. The default value is 1800 seconds
(30 minutes). A value of 0 indicates an unlimited maximum lifetime (infinite lifetime). The minimum
allowed value is 30 seconds. This can be changed through the configuration API with the
`ballerina.sql.maxConnectionLifeTime` key.

fields.name: minIdleConnections
fields.description:
The minimum number of idle connections that the pool tries to maintain. The default value is the same as
`maxOpenConnections` and it can be changed through the configuration API with the
`ballerina.sql.minIdleConnections` key

fields.name: connectionTimeout
fields.description:
Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a connection from the pool before failing. The default value is
30 seconds. This can be changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.connectionTimeout` key

fields.name: idleTimeout
fields.description:
Maximum time (in seconds) an idle connection is kept before retirement. The default value is 600 seconds
(10 minutes). This can be changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.idleTimeout` key

fields.name: validationTimeout
fields.description:
Maximum time (in seconds) allowed for a connection validation. The default value is 5 seconds. This
can be changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.validationTimeout` key

fields.name: leakDetectionThreshold
fields.description:
Threshold (in seconds) to flag a potential connection leak (use `0` to disable leak detection). The default
value is 0 seconds. This can be changed through the configuration API with the
`ballerina.sql.leakDetectionThreshold` key

fields.name: keepAliveTime
fields.description:
Interval (in seconds) to periodically keep idle connections alive (use `0` to disable keep alive). The
default value is 0 seconds. This can be changed through the configuration API with the
`ballerina.sql.keepAliveTime` key

fields.name: poolName
fields.description:
Pool name for logs/metrics. If unset, an internal name is used. The default value is nil. This can be
changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.poolName` key

fields.name: initializationFailTimeout
fields.description:
Controls pool boot behavior: fail fast vs. lazy init. Use negative value to disable failure timeout. The
default value is 1 second. This can be changed through the configuration API with the
`ballerina.sql.initializationFailTimeout` key

fields.name: transactionIsolation
fields.description:
Default transaction isolation for connections. If unset, driver default is used. Allowed values typically:
`TRANSACTION_READ_UNCOMMITTED`, `TRANSACTION_READ_COMMITTED`, `TRANSACTION_REPEATABLE_READ`,
`TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE`.
This can be changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.transactionIsolation` key

fields.name: connectionTestQuery
fields.description:
SQL query to validate a connection. Leave unset to use driver-native validation. The default value is
nil. This can be changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.connectionTestQuery` key

fields.name: connectionInitSql
fields.description:
SQL executed when a new connection is created. Useful for session-level settings. The default value is
nil. This can be changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.connectionInitSql` key

fields.name: readOnly
fields.description:
Marks connections as read-only by default. Use with care when apps issue writes. The default value is
false. This can be changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.readOnly` key

fields.name: allowPoolSuspension
fields.description:
Allows suspending the pool for maintenance. Rarely needed; keep disabled. The default value is false.
This can be changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.allowPoolSuspension` key

fields.name: isolateInternalQueries
fields.description:
Isolates pool's internal queries from application transactions. The default value is false. This can
be changed through the configuration API with the `ballerina.sql.isolateInternalQueries` key

typeDefs.description: Represents the transaction isolation level.

typeDefs.name: BatchExecuteErrorDetail
typeDefs.description: Represents the properties belonging to an `sql:BatchExecuteError`.

fields.description: SQL error code

fields.name: sqlState
fields.description: SQL state

fields.name: executionResults
fields.description: Metadata of the query executions

typeDefs.name: ExecutionResult
typeDefs.description: Metadata of the query execution.

fields.name: affectedRowCount
fields.description:
Number of rows affected by the execution of the query. It may be one of the following,
(1) A number greater than or equal to zero, the count of affected rows after the successful execution of the query
(2) A value of the `SUCCESS_NO_INFO`, the count of affected rows is unknown after the successful execution of the query
(3) A value of the `EXECUTION_FAILED`, the query execution failed

fields.name: lastInsertId
fields.description: The ID generated by the database in response to a query execution. This can be `()` in case the database does not support this feature

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Defines the generic error type for the `sql` module.

typeDefs.name: DatabaseError
typeDefs.description:
Represents an error caused by an issue related to database accessibility, erroneous queries, constraint violations,
database resource clean-up, and other similar scenarios.

typeDefs.name: BatchExecuteError
typeDefs.description: Represents an error that occurs during the execution of batch queries.

typeDefs.name: NoRowsError
typeDefs.description: Represents an error that occurs when a query retrieves does not retrieve any rows when at least one row is expected.

typeDefs.name: ApplicationError
typeDefs.description: Represents an error originating from application-level configurations.

typeDefs.name: DataError
typeDefs.description: Represents an error that occurs during the processing of the parameters or returned results.

typeDefs.name: TypeMismatchError
typeDefs.description: Represents an error that occurs when a query retrieves a result that differs from the supported result type.

typeDefs.name: ConversionError
typeDefs.description: Represents an error that occurs when a query retrieves a result that is corrupted and cannot be converted to the expected type.

typeDefs.name: FieldMismatchError
typeDefs.description: Represents an error that occurs when a query retrieves a result that cannot be mapped to the expected record type.

typeDefs.name: UnsupportedTypeError
typeDefs.description: Represents an error that occurs when an unsupported parameter type is added to the query.

typeDefs.name: ParameterizedQuery
typeDefs.description:
The object constructed through backtick surrounded strings. Dynamic parameters of `sql:Value` type can be indicated using `${<variable name>}`
such as `` `The sql:ParameterizedQuery is ${variable_name}` ``.
This validates the parameter types during the query execution.

typeDefs.name: Parameter
typeDefs.description: Generic type that can be passed to `sql:ParameterizedCallQuery` to indicate procedure/function parameters.

typeDefs.name: ParameterizedCallQuery
typeDefs.description:
The object constructed through backtick surrounded strings. Dynamic parameters of `sql:Parameter` type can be indicated using `${<variable name>}`
such as `` `The sql:ParameterizedQuery is ${variable_name}` ``.
This validates the parameter types during the query execution.
Identifiers like table names or column names cannot be changed dynamically through parameters. In scenarios where dynamic identifiers are required,
queries can be safely constructed using string interpolation.

functions.name: getNextQueryResult
functions.description:
Updates `executionResult` or `queryResult` field with the succeeding result in the result list. This will also close the current
result when called. The `close` method must be called once all the results are processed.

return.description: True if the next result is `queryResult`

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Releases the associated resources such as the database connection, results, etc.
This method must be called once all results are processed.

return.description: An `sql:Error` if any error occurred while cleanup

functions.name: getGlobalConnectionPool
functions.description: Returns the global connection pool.

return.description: The connection pool

functions.name: queryConcat
functions.description: Concatenates all provided `sql:ParameterizedQuery`s into a single `sql:ParameterizedQuery`.

parameters.name: queries
parameters.description: Set of `sql:ParameterizedQuery` queries

return.description: An `sql:ParameterizedQuery`

functions.name: arrayFlattenQuery
functions.description: Joins the parameters in the array with the `,` delimiter into an `sql:ParameterizedQuery`.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: An array of `sql:Value` values

return.description: An `sql:ParameterizedQuery`

functions.name: generateApplicationErrorStream
functions.description: Generates a stream consisting of `sql:Error` elements.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Error message used to initialise an `sql:Error`

return.description: A stream
